headline: Bharat Semi raises $24M seed for AI-enabled image sensors
quote: The all-equity seed round was led by Info Edge Group, South Park Commons, and Indus Bridge Ventures
claim: Indian semiconductor startup Bharat Semi raised $24 million in seed funding to develop AI-enabled image sensors, in a round led by Info Edge Group, South Park Commons and Indus Bridge Ventures.
why_it_matters: Shows Indian money going into AI hardware at the edge, not only apps and models.
title: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi lands $24M seed round as it eyes global AI sensor market | TechCrunch

headline: OpenAI starts processing Indian business API requests inside India
quote: OpenAI will now run AI requests from Indian business customers on servers inside India.
claim: OpenAI will now run AI requests from Indian business customers on servers inside India under what it calls API inference residency, keeping both data and computation in the country.
why_it_matters: Banks and regulated firms that could not send data abroad can now use OpenAI APIs, so more India-based AI jobs and projects open up.
title: OpenAI Brings AI Processing Inside India, Easing a Key Hurdle for Banks and Enterprises – IT VoiceOpenAI Brings AI Processing to India for Banks and Enterprises
